Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 dummy VARCHAR2(1);
 v_local_date DATE := SYSDATE; -- SCR 18938
 l_date DATE;
BEGIN
 -- Calculate local time (SCR 18938)
 IF is_timezone_enabled THEN
 --lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:GLOBAL.chapter_id, SYSDATE, v_local_date);
 l_date:= Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate);
 END IF;
 
 :GLOBAL.test_error := '';
 
 IF (:control_block.test_id IS NOT NULL) THEN
 
 BEGIN
 /*SELECT 'x'
 INTO dummy
 FROM valid_tests
 WHERE test_id = :control_block.test_id AND
 --SYSDATE BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+365); -- SCR18938
 --v_local_date BETWEEN eff_date AND NVL(term_date, SYSDATE+365)--IM 6959
 lifetrack_timezone_convert.is_current_date(:GLOBAL.chapter_id,eff_date,term_date,sysdate) = 'Y'
 ;*/
 
 SELECT 'x'
 INTO dummy
 FROM contract_tests ct,
 valid_tests vt
 WHERE ct.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id
 AND ct.test_id = vt.test_id
 AND vt.test_id = :control_block.test_id -- Added for MLT-512
 AND profile_set_id IN
 (SELECT profile_set_id
 FROM rgt_tubes
 WHERE contract_id=:control_block.contract_id
 AND chapter_id =:global.chapter_id
 )
 AND profile_set_id IN
 (SELECT profile_set_id
 FROM rgt_contract_profile rcp
 WHERE contract_id=:control_block.contract_id
 AND l_date BETWEEN rcp.eff_date AND NVL(rcp.term_date,l_date+365)
 )
 AND l_date BETWEEN ct.eff_date AND NVL(ct.term_date,l_date+365)
 ORDER BY ct.test_id;
 
 IF dummy = 'x' THEN
 :GLOBAL.test_error := '';
 END IF;
 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 :GLOBAL.test_error := 'Y';
 GO_ITEM('control_block.test_id');
 show_error('1227');
 check_package_failure;
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 END IF;
END;

procedure check_interim is
begin
 NULL;
 /* Commented as this is a query screen and this proc is not used anywhere in the program (as part of SCR 18938)
 
 :global.interim_found := '';
 begin
 insert into rgt_interim_results
 (unit_id, coll_date, test_id, result_code,test_seq_no,batch_id,
 chapter_id,contract_id,insert_dats,insert_user_id)
 select u.unit_id, u.coll_date, ut.test_id, ut.result_status_1,
 ut.test_seq_no,
 :control_block.batch_id,:control_block.chapter_id,
 :control_block.contract_id,
 sysdate, decode(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,1,4),'OPS$',upper(substr(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid,5
)),upper(LT_USER_SESSION.get_userid))
 from units u, utrs ut
 where
 u.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and
 u.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and
 u.batch_id = :control_block.batch_id and
 u.unit_id = ut.unit_id and
 ut.chapter_id = :control_block.chapter_id and
 u.coll_date = ut.coll_date and
 ut.result_status_1 is null and
 not exists (select 'x' from rgt_interim_results rgt
 where
 rgt.unit_id = u.unit_id and
 rgt.chapter_id = u.chapter_id and
 rgt.coll_date = u.coll_date and
 rgt.contract_id = :control_block.contract_id and
 rgt.test_id = ut.test_id and
 rgt.test_seq_no = ut.test_seq_no);
 if SQL%FOUND = FALSE then
 :global.interim_found := 'N';
 show_error('1061');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 null;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 */
end;
